rounds.v.rpg.name: RPG Arena
rounds.v.rpg.desc: Everyone gets the RPG (knife slot): rocket jump, splash your enemies, a direct hit in the air kills. No fall damage.
rounds.v.rocketrain.name: Rocket Rain
rounds.v.rocketrain.desc: Fast-firing launchers with a big clip - but only players in the air can be hurt. Keep jumping!
rounds.v.knives.name: Throwing Knives
rounds.v.knives.desc: Knives only, and every swing throws one. 100 damage per hit, double on the head.
rounds.v.dodgeball.name: Dodgeball
rounds.v.dodgeball.desc: Decoys only, one hit kills, a new decoy after every throw. Floaty gravity.
rounds.v.scoutz.name: Scoutz Knivez
rounds.v.scoutz.desc: SSG 08 and knife in low gravity. No fall damage.
rounds.v.oitc.name: One in the Chamber
rounds.v.oitc.desc: A Deagle with one bullet that always kills. Every kill gives you a bullet back - miss and it's knife time.
rounds.v.gungame.name: Gun Game
rounds.v.gungame.desc: Every kill gives you the next weapon. A knife kill on the last level wins the round; getting knifed costs a level.
rounds.v.heparty.name: HE Party
rounds.v.heparty.desc: HE grenades only, refilled after every throw, in low gravity.
rounds.v.headshots.name: Deagle Headshots
rounds.v.headshots.desc: Deagles with endless ammo - only headshots deal damage.
rounds.v.lowgrav.name: Low Gravity
rounds.v.lowgrav.desc: Your usual weapons, but everyone floats. No fall damage.
rounds.v.vampire.name: Vampire
rounds.v.vampire.desc: Half the damage you deal heals you - up to 150 HP.
rounds.v.speed.name: Speed
rounds.v.speed.desc: Your usual weapons, and everyone runs 50% faster.
rounds.v.glass.name: Glass Cannon
rounds.v.glass.desc: Everyone spawns with very little health and no armour. One good shot is all it takes.
rounds.v.bounty.name: Bounty Hunter
rounds.v.bounty.desc: One player glows gold and carries the bounty. Their kills raise its value; whoever kills them cashes in and becomes the bounty.
rounds.v.juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
rounds.v.juggernaut.desc: One slow, armoured player with a Negev and a mountain of HP. Kill them for big points and take their place.
rounds.v.lastman.name: Last Man Standing
rounds.v.lastman.desc: Everyone has 3 lives. Out of lives means out of the round - the last one alive wins.
